textRuns.value: A 40-seat House swing and 8-seat Senate gain reversed the 2024 red wave across 47 states.
AK, LA, NC have no 2026 split in source data and appear blank on the map.
Democrats swept Texas statewide races (Gov +7.1, Sen +12.1, AG +6.5) and gained 14 House seats.
Margins reflect statewide general election certified totals, with 2026 preliminary.
Record campaign receipts ($4.24B) met high midterm turnout and narrowed margins in 74 competitive House races.
Turnout data ends at 2022; official 2026 VEPM turnout is not yet published.

Negative values indicate seat losses for the party holding the White House.
Divided government returns as Democrats gain trifecta-breaking control of both congressional chambers.
Trifecta is broken when the presidency and both chambers of Congress are not held by the same party.
